name: codetr-context-plus-free-category-v1
development_scope: 54 provisional visual references, 13 clean / 20 defective / 21 gray; no holdout labels inspected for method selection
detector: Co-DETR ViT-L existing native mmdet runtime and checkpoint
detector_view: 3x candidate width and height, minimum 128px per side, image-clipped context; no candidate outline or class supplied
semantic_observer: official Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, exact reground-dev-v1 point prompts, original image and fixed half-image context
semantic_rule: at least one valid resolved observation has a canonical category exactly equal to candidate category; generic/unknown/unmapped categories provide no support
admission_rule: detector score/IoU gate AND semantic support; otherwise unknown, never an automatic negative
localization_output: detector agreement is only eligible for bounded acceptable-localization proxy after independent holdout acceptance; it is not ground truth
duplicate_scope: strict pairwise IoU>.95 is separate automatic rule; lower-IoU cross-prediction duplication remains outside this profile
holdout: holdout-v1/candidates.jsonl: 64 images disjoint from 39 development images, sha256 bae64e2d9549ffc8549c255be1614f0893cae757e1fadd188e2ebcba28f61b3d
validation: original contract.md thresholds unchanged; no tuning or case-specific exceptions from holdout outcomes
